Daily Quiz.question: ১) Which one of the following  is a simple sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is poor but honest
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Though he is poor, he is honest
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) In spite of his poverty, he is honest
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He is poor and honest
Daily Quiz.exp: একটি simple sentence এ শুধুমাত্র একটি clause থাকে অর্থাৎ একটি subject এবং একটি finite verb থাকে, এছাড়া  simple sentence সাধারণত  In spite of,  Despite,Because of ইত্যাদি থাকে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Which is the correct simple sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The sun rose and the fog dispersed
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The fog being dispersed, the sun rose
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) When the sun rose, the fog dispersed.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The sun having risen, the fog dispersed
Daily Quiz.exp: সাধারণত সূর্য উঠলে কুয়াশা কাটে, তাই বাক্যের যোগ্যতা ঠিক রাখতে সঠিক উত্তর হবে ঘ।

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Which one of the  following is a complex sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) If I know this before!
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Do you not repent for this?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) A villain alone can do it
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I know why he is silent
Daily Quiz.exp: Complex sentence  এ সাধারণত একটি প্রধান  clause  এবং এক বা একাধিক  নির্ভরশীল clause থাকে। Complex Sentence এ Whom, Whose, Which, because, since, for, as if, Though,  Although,after,before,So that, In order that, Till, Until, Than ইত্যাদি  দ্বারা একাধিক clause যুক্ত থাকে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Does he wish me to go. Which one is Complex  for this sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Does he want that I should go?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Does he wish my going
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Does he wish that I should go
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Does he wish that I may go
Daily Quiz.exp:
Simple: subject+ want/wish/like/desire+object+infinitive
Complex : Subject + want/ wish/like/desire+ that + object টি subject হয়+ should+ infinitive এর verb থেকে বাকি অংশ বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) There is no mother but loves her children. The sentence is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Simple
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Complex
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Compound
Daily Quiz.exp: প্রদত্ত বাক্যে but আছে এ কারনে মনে হতে পারে এটি Compound sentence কিন্তু বাক্যে but আসলে negative relative pronoun অর্থাৎ who does not অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে তাই sentence টি Complex sentence  হবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Do or die is a-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Compound sentence
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Simple sentence
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Complex sentence
Daily Quiz.exp: Compound Sentence  একের অধিক  principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়। এছাড়া Compound Sentence এ সাধারণত  and,  or, but, yet,so,therefore,otherwise,both-and, either-or, neither-nor, not only -but also ইত্যাদি  co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি  principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।
